qa_pairs.question: What equipment should be set up before beginning the engine carrier welding procedure?
qa_pairs.answer: Set up car on straightening bench and set up engine carrier.

qa_pairs.question: How should the engine carrier be welded to the car body?
qa_pairs.answer: Plug spot weld engine carrier through provided holes.

qa_pairs.question: What additional component needs to be installed according to the instructions?
What should be done to all welding seams after the welding is complete?
qa_pairs.answer: Seal all welding seams with joint sealing compound.

qa_pairs.question: What should be done if the anti-drumming compound is damaged?
Where can I find instructions for installing the wheel house?
qa_pairs.answer: See section 41 14 021 for wheel house installation instructions.

qa_pairs.question: What is the source reference listed at the bottom of the page?
What type of welding method is specified for attaching the engine carrier?
qa_pairs.answer: Plug spot welding is specified for attaching the engine carrier.

qa_pairs.question: What should be used to seal the welding seams?
qa_pairs.answer: Joint sealing compound should be used to seal all welding seams.

qa_pairs.question: Where are the holes located for welding the engine carrier?
qa_pairs.answer: The holes are provided in the engine carrier itself for plug spot welding.

qa_pairs.question: What page number is shown at the top of this manual page?
qa_pairs.answer: Page 41-107 is shown at the top of this manual page.
